title: US estate tax exposure of a non-US person holding US-situs assets

source.title: IRS, Some nonresidents with U.S. assets must file estate tax returns (last reviewed 27-Jun-2026); Instructions for Form 706-NA (09/2025)

estate_threshold.notes: AMOUNT IS IN US DOLLARS, NOT NIS: USD 60,000. The schema unit list has no currency-neutral money unit, so unit is 'nis' only because no better unit exists; read the 'currency' field. This is the filing threshold: the executor of a nonresident non-citizen files Form 706-NA when the fair market value at death of US-situated assets exceeds USD 60,000. Not stated to be indexed. Israel has no estate-tax treaty with the US.
